QuestInfo.name: Hide Yo Ingredients
QuestInfo.0: The joy did not last long. Selene seems to be concerned.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000006# tells you that her ingredients are disappearing! See if you can get #p3000000#'s help.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000000# wants to help, but he's too busy. You've been tasked with finding the missing ingredients!

0.0: Angelic Buster, can you... No, forget it. \r\n#L0##bWhat is it? I bet I can!#l\n#k
0.1: I-I don't want to get anyone in trouble, but I'm quite certain that a thief is stealing my food. Should I tell that handsome young #p3000000# about it?

yes.0: You should be able to find #p3000000# in front of the #m400000000#'s Community Hall.

no.0: Do you think it's just the poor accounting skills of a doddering old lady?

1.0: Oh, hey! Good to see you again, really. Really good.

yes.0: #p3000006# thinks she's got a thief, does she? Well, if it worries the great Angelic Buster, it's certainly enough for my attention.
yes.1: I'll let you know when my troops get to the bottom of it. In the meantime, you could go see #b#p3000003##k in #r#m400000001##k if you need more work. Or you could just stay here.

npc.0: Did I confuse you with all my big words? #p3000000# is right in front of the #m400000000# Community Hall...
